candidates.extracted_text: Item 1. Business Applied Materials, Inc. (AMAT) is a registrant under the Securities Exchange Act. Applied Materials supplies manufacturing equipment and services used to produce semiconductor chips, including deposition and related wafer-fab tools. Principal operations: Applied Materials, Inc.. Reported segments include: Semiconductor Systems (78% of revenue); Applied Global Services (22% of revenue). Our semiconductor business model is equipment. We supply wafer fabrication equipment to semiconductor manufacturers.
